---

Every update to an NCCS core dataset ships with a plain-language
release note: what changed, whether existing records were revised or
only added, and its verification status. Notes are authored once, in
the [NCCS data governance record](https://github.com/UrbanInstitute/nccs-contracts/tree/main/governance/release-notes),
and this page is generated from them - it is never edited by hand.

```{r}
#| output: asis

files <- sort(list.files("release-notes-data", full.names = TRUE),
              decreasing = TRUE)
if (length(files) == 0) {
  cat("*(No release notes fetched - run catalogs/get-release-notes.R.)*\n")
} else {
  for (f in files) {
    txt <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
    # demote headings one level so notes nest under the page title
    txt <- gsub("^# ", "## ", txt)
    txt <- gsub("^## (.*)$", "## \\1", txt)
    cat(txt, sep = "\n"); cat("\n\n---\n\n")
  }
}
```
